# sofascore_scraper.store.Lease
# kaynak: sofascore_scraper/store/lease.py
class Lease:
    def __init__(self, name: str, purpose: str, handles: List[Tuple[int, Region]], *, on_release: Optional[Callable[['Lease'], None]] = None) -> None
    self.name
    self.purpose
    self.holder
    self.pid
    self.host
    self.acquired_at
    self.unclean
    @property
    def held(self) -> bool
    def info(self) -> LeaseInfo
    def release(self) -> None
    def __enter__(self) -> 'Lease'
    def __exit__(self, *exc_info: Any) -> None
    def __del__(self) -> None
    def __repr__(self) -> str
